quotes.quote: Describe the “good enough” OSV record that will be imported by OSV.dev
a record passes JSON Schema validation for the version of the OSV Schema it declares itself to comply with in the schema_version field
Package-level precision is the minimum standard.
introduced and fixed versions or commits can’t be the same
for commit (GIT) ranges the commits exist in the specified repo (i.e. they are not from another GitHub fork)
reference URLs return a 2xx or 3xx response at the time of publication
